classes.name: association
classes.label: association
classes.definition: not-for-profit organization that is owned by and acts on behalf of its members

classes.name: cooperative society
classes.label: cooperative society
classes.definition: organization owned by and operated for the benefit of those using its services

classes.name: family office
classes.label: family office
classes.definition: organization that assumes the day-to-day administration and management of a family's affairs

classes.name: functional business entity
classes.label: functional business entity
classes.definition: functional entity defined in terms of the nature of the commercial activity it conducts

classes.name: functional entity
classes.label: functional entity
classes.definition: party defined in terms of a function they or it performs

classes.name: merchant
classes.label: merchant
classes.definition: party engaged in the purchase and sales of goods produced by others for profit

classes.name: merchant category code
classes.label: merchant category code
classes.definition: code used internationally to classify a merchant

classes.name: merchant category code scheme
classes.label: merchant category code scheme
classes.definition: scheme defining a set of codes for classifying merchant services

classes.name: merchant identifier
classes.label: merchant identifier
classes.definition: unique identifier for a merchant that is used, for example, for transaction interchange purposes

classes.name: syndicate
classes.label: syndicate
classes.definition: temporary, self-organizing group of people, companies, corporations or entities organized as an alliance whose purpose is to transact some specific business, or to pursue or promote a shared interest

classes.name: syndicate member
classes.label: syndicate member
classes.definition: role of an individual or organization that is a member of an alliance set up to pool resources and share risk with respect to a large transaction

classes.name: API-first market data provider
classes.label: API-first market data provider
classes.definition: market data provider that delivers financial information primarily through programmatic interfaces, offering real-time or historical data via APIs for automated consumption

classes.name: alternative data provider
classes.label: alternative data provider
classes.definition: market data provider that supplies non-traditional datasets derived from sources such as web activity, sentiment analysis, geospatial signals, or other alternative information channels

classes.name: crypto and digital-asset data provider
classes.label: crypto and digital-asset data provider
classes.definition: market data provider that supplies pricing, reference data, and analytics for digital tokens and crypto-assets

classes.name: derivatives and volatility data provider
classes.label: derivatives and volatility data provider
classes.definition: market data provider that supplies pricing, implied-volatility surfaces, and analytics for derivatives, including options, futures, and structured products

classes.name: exchange-sourced data provider
classes.label: exchange-sourced data provider
classes.definition: market data provider that distributes financial information originating directly from trading venues, including order-book data, trades, quotes, and venue-specific reference data

classes.name: fixed income specialist provider
classes.label: fixed income specialist provider
classes.definition: market data provider that focuses on pricing, reference data, and analytics for fixed-income instruments such as bonds, credit products, and money-market securities

classes.name: institutional market data provider
classes.label: institutional market data provider
classes.definition: market data provider that supplies multi-asset financial information, analytics, and reference data to financial institutions such as banks, asset managers, and trading firms

classes.name: market data provider
classes.label: market data provider
classes.definition: publisher that supplies financial information, reference data, analytics, or related datasets used in financial markets

classes.name: publication
classes.label: publication
classes.definition: document offered for general distribution and usually produced in multiple copies

classes.name: publisher
classes.label: publisher
classes.definition: role of person(s) or organization(s) responsible for the printing or distribution of an item, whether in digital or print (physical) form

classes.name: reference data specialist provider
classes.label: reference data specialist provider
classes.definition: market data provider that focuses on authoritative reference data, including corporate actions, instrument identifiers, classifications, and entity information aligned with ISO standards

edges.name: has publisher
edges.label: has publisher
edges.definition: indicates the party in the role of issuing the information

edges.name: is published by
edges.label: is published by
edges.definition: identifies the independent party (i.e., the individual or organization) that disseminates the material

edges.name: publishes
edges.label: publishes
edges.definition: prepares and issues material for public consumption

attributes.name: has merchant category description
attributes.label: has merchant category description
attributes.definition: provides a text description of the sector to which the code applies
